svg.title: Escalation ladder
svg.desc: Three stacked boxes. Bottom, tag 1, gray: the skill, which reports success or a failure reason. Middle, tag 2, blue: the behavior tree, which can retry, time out or take another branch. Top, tag 3, red: the planner or LLM agent, which makes a new plan or takes a new goal. Arrows on the left point up: status and the failure reason move up. Arrows on the right point down: commands move down. A bracket marks the skill and the tree as local recovery, and the planner or agent as global recovery.
